name: Get-WinEvent - PowerShell Event Log Analysis
command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='<log>'; ID=<id>} | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, Message | Format-List
description: Get-WinEvent PowerShell cmdlet for querying Windows event logs. Supports FilterHashtable (fastest), FilterXPath (flexible), and FilterXml (complex). Use for live log analysis and offline .evtx analysis during incident response.
source: CDSA Module 03: Windows Event Logs & Finding Evil
notes:
=== Enumerate Available Logs ===
  Get-WinEvent -ListLog * | Select-Object LogName, RecordCount, IsClassicLog, IsEnabled, LogMode, LogType | Format-Table -AutoSize
  Get-WinEvent -ListProvider * | Format-Table -AutoSize
  Get-WinEvent -ListProvider '*Sysmon*'

=== Basic Log Reads ===
  Get-WinEvent -LogName 'System' -MaxEvents 50
  Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-WinRM/Operational' -MaxEvents 30 | Select-Object TimeCreated, ID, ProviderName, LevelDisplayName, Message | Format-Table -AutoSize
  # Read from oldest first:
  Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-WinRM/Operational' -Oldest -MaxEvents 30
  # Read from offline .evtx file:
  Get-WinEvent -Path 'C:\Logs\DLLHijack\sysmon.evtx' -MaxEvents 5 | Select-Object TimeCreated, ID, ProviderName, LevelDisplayName, Message | Format-Table -AutoSize

=== FilterHashtable (fastest — preferred for performance) ===
  Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'; ID=1,3}
  # Offline file:
  Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{Path='C:\Logs\exec_sysmon.evtx'; ID=1,3}
  # With date range:
  $startDate = (Get-Date -Year 2023 -Month 3 -Day 3)
  $endDate   = (Get-Date -Year 2023 -Month 3 -Day 6)
  Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'; ID=1,3; StartTime=$startDate; EndTime=$endDate}

=== FilterXPath — field-level filtering ===
  # Events where DestinationIp is specific IP (Sysmon Event 3):
  Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath "*[System[EventID=3] and EventData[Data[@Name='DestinationIp']='52.113.194.132']]"
  # ProcessCreate where Image contains svchost:
  Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' -FilterXPath "*[System[EventID=1] and EventData[Data[@Name='Image']='C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe']]"

=== FilterXml — most powerful, pass as variable ===
  $Query = @'
  <QueryList>
    <Query Id="0">
      <Select Path="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational">
        *[System[EventID=7]] and *[EventData[Data[@Name='ImageLoaded'] and (Data='C:\Windows\System32\clr.dll')]]
      </Select>
    </Query>
  </QueryList>
  '@
  Get-WinEvent -FilterXml $Query

=== XML Parsing for Specific Fields ===
  # Extract DestinationIp from Sysmon Event 3 via XML:
  Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'; ID=3} | ForEach-Object {
    $xml = [xml]$_.ToXml()
    $ip  = ($xml.Event.EventData.Data | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'DestinationIp'}).'#text'
    [PSCustomObject]@{TimeCreated=$_.TimeCreated; DestinationIp=$ip}
  }

=== Detect Base64-Encoded Commands (Properties[21]) ===
  # Sysmon Event 1: CommandLine is in Properties[21]
  Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'; ID=1} | Where-Object {$_.Properties[21].Value -like '*-enc*'} | Format-List

=== Log Channel Names ===
  Security                                          → security events (4624, 4625, etc.)
  System                                            → system events (7045 service install)
  Application                                       → app-level events
  Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational              → Sysmon
  Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational          → PS script block logging (event 4104)
  Microsoft-Windows-WinRM/Operational               → WinRM
  Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational       → scheduled tasks
  Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational    → Defender detections

examples.label: List all available event logs with record counts
examples.command: Get-WinEvent -ListLog * | Select-Object LogName, RecordCount, IsEnabled | Where-Object {$_.RecordCount -gt 0} | Format-Table -AutoSize

examples.label: Read last 50 System log events
examples.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName 'System' -MaxEvents 50 | Select-Object TimeCreated, ID, ProviderName, LevelDisplayName, Message | Format-Table -AutoSize

examples.label: Read from offline .evtx file
examples.command: Get-WinEvent -Path 'C:\Logs\DLLHijack\sysmon.evtx' -MaxEvents 5 | Select-Object TimeCreated, ID, Message | Format-Table -AutoSize

examples.label: FilterHashtable — Sysmon events 1 and 3
examples.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'; ID=1,3} | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, Message | Format-List
